 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE DR. ANSHUMAN  ORAL ORDER 6 20-06-2023
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned counsel for the State and learned counsel for the NHAI.

2. Counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner has grievances against the respondent on the compensation amount for the land which has been acquired for the purpose of construction of National Highway.
Counsel fairly submits that under law particularly in the light of Section 3G (5) of the National Highway Act, 1956, his remedy lies before Arbitrator (Commissioner, Darbhanga).

He further submits that petitioner Patna High Court CWJC No.95 of 2021(6) dt.20-06-2023 has already filed his statement of claim before the Arbitrator which is annexed as Annexure-4 in the writ petition but there is no development and matter is pending since 2020.

sentences.text: 3. Counsel for the State and counsel for the NHAI submit that the petitioner is not entitled for any relief from this Court as he has already filed an application seeking appropriate remedy before the competent forum.
4. In this background, the Commissioner, Darbhanga is directed to decide the arbitration proceeding as claimed by the petitioner filed in the year 2020 as expeditiously as possible.
5. With this observation, the present Writ Petition stands disposed off.
